text:
oliver.stone: FYI found an odd revrec hit tied to FX revaluation on EUR prepaid customers migrated to US ledger. Customer: Solstice AI (contract S-2070-EUR). About $15,430 USD of prepaid revenue appears to have been recognized this period due to FX realized gain being posted to revenue instead of an FX gain/loss account. Affected invoices: INV-2070-7001 (EUR original), INV-2070-7002 (FX-adjustment). Need revrec treatment and JE guidance before close.

marie.keller: whoa. Is the system converting EUR invoices to USD for GL posting? I thought FX P&L hits were isolated to FX GL 6100.

daniel.choi: short version: billing conversion job converts invoice totals to USD using daily rate and posts two lines: invoice revenue (USD) + fx reval line. The fx reval line was accidentally mapped to revenue GL (4000) instead of FX GL (6100) when ledger mapping for EUR region was updated last month.

oliver.stone: quick calc pasted:
- Original prepaid (EUR): 120,000
- Posted USD revenue this period: 118,430
- Expected recognized (deferred schedule): 103,000
- Difference (FX posted to revenue): 15,430 USD

marie.keller: SQL to trace posting:
```sql
SELECT g.entry_id, g.account_gl, g.amount_usd, g.description
FROM finance.general_ledger g
JOIN billing.invoices i on g.source_invoice = i.id
WHERE i.contract_id = 'S-2070-EUR' AND g.posted_date >= '2025-06-01'
ORDER BY g.posted_date;
```

billing-bot: billing-bot: LEDGER-MAP RUN 1937998000: ledger mapping update applied region->GL mapping file v2.4. Log: /var/log/billing/ledger_map/1937998000.log

elaine.ops: propose JE to correct recognition: debit Revenue (GL 4000) 15,430; credit Deferred Revenue (GL 2005) 15,430. Memo: "Correcting FX revaluation mistakenly posted to revenue (EUR->USD ledger mapping misconfiguration) for S-2070-EUR." Also move the FX line from 4000 to FX gain GL 6100 for prior entry—will need adjusting entry.

daniel.choi: agree. We should also correct the original misposted FX line by moving 15,430 from 4000 to 6100 (journal to reclass). That will leave revenue unaffected after the reversing JE + reclass.

marie.keller: can we combine into two-line JE? Line 1: debit Rev 4000 15,430 credit Deferred 2005 15,430. Line 2: debit Rev 4000 15,430 credit FX Gain 6100 15,430 to reclass the misposted FX. Net effect: revenue reduced, deferred increased, FX recorded properly. Approve?

oliver.stone: approved. Please attach GL extract and conversion audit.

billing-bot: ATTACHMENT: /var/log/billing/ledger_map/1937998000.log and /var/log/billing/conversion/1937999000.csv uploaded.

elaine.ops: creating JE now JE# 2070-JUN-FX-001 (pending). Posting description: reclass FX reval and reverse erroneous recognition for S-2070-EUR. Will attach GL query output and conversion audit.

auditor_bot: note: include currency rates used and approval chain in JE support per SOX reqs.

daniel.choi: rates: 2025-06-15 EUR->USD 1.0365 used for conversion. I'll paste conversion snapshot in the attach. Also filing BE ticket BE-5501 to add a ledger-mapping validation unit test and a preflight that checks GL account existence before mapping deploy. Assigning to billing infra.

billing-bot: TICKET CREATED BE-5501 - ledger mapping validation and preflight. Assigned daniel.choi.

marie.keller: will run a sweep for EUR-origin prepaid invoices this month to estimate scope. If small, aggregate JE ok; if material, we'll need per-contract JEs. Quick scan estimate = 7 contracts, exposure ~48,900 USD.

elaine.ops: propose batching into single reversing/reclass JE for the material items and attach per-contract schedule. Approve?

oliver.stone: agree to batch. Just ensure each contract is listed in the JE attachment with calculation.

elaine.ops: JE created JE# 2070-JUN-FX-001 (pending). Attachments: GL extract, conversion audit, per-contract schedule. Posting will occur before COB.

marie.keller: adding one-line note to close pack about the mapping issue and the JE ref. Also will include ARR/NRR delta.

daniel.choi: after JE posts, I'll deploy a rollback on the ledger mapping change to revert to v2.3 and push the validation patch.

billing-bot: LEDGER-MAP ROLLBACK SCHEDULED: rollback to v2.3 at 2025-06-16T02:00Z.

elaine.ops: JE posted. Posting note: JE# 2070-JUN-FX-001; reverse recognition 15,430 USD to Deferred GL 2005 and reclass FX 15,430 USD to GL 6100. Deferred schedule updated and attached to close pack.

oliver.stone: thanks all. tagging accounting and billing infra to ensure remediation tests are green. :thumbsup:
